title: 2.1.3 release readiness: the MOSS release (MOSS-Image, Multi-angle, Singularity H3)
description: The MOSS release = 2.1.3 (Fabio, 2026-10-25). Members so far: MOSS-Image and its follow-ups (MPI-1243, MPI-1245, MPI-1249, MPI-1253: done, waiting on this release); Multi-angle Flow (MPI-1039, ships with MOSS per Fabio 2026-10-24); Singularity H3 v2 as the ONLY MiniMax H3 model (MPI-1284): this release marks MiniMax H3 (fl2va) and MiniMax H3 Reference (ref2va) DEPRECATED and releases Singularity H3. Licence check first, deprecate per docs/playbooks/add-model 'Removing or re-tiering', never delete dep entries. Bench evidence: MPI-1135 validation.md (Phase 1, 1b). Candidate ride-alongs from the same bench, not yet assigned to a release: MPI-1283 (sections in H3 ref prompts), MPI-1285 (Fast Motion control). LTX 2.5 is NOT in this release (MPI-1267). Version number and the cut stay Fabio's call.
